# vue fixture

A Vue SFC (`<script setup>` + `defineProps`). react-docgen-typescript only
understands React component shapes (FC/class/forwardRef); a `.vue` SFC has
none of those, so `parse()` returns no docs for this file. Expected: unsupported —
`tttGet` throws "No component found".
